title: StopGateArtifact
description: Formal, signed, evidence-bound stop-gate attestation; a specialization of ReceiptIR that binds a deterministic gate verdict to hashed EvidenceIR and a temporal window. Emitted by the harness, consumed by a lift_authority. Distinct from the legacy check-based stop-gate-artifact.schema.v0.1.json.

subject.description: The action(s) being gated, e.g. ["git push", "git tag"].

predicate_layer.description: The layer the predicate binds to. A gate on task outcome is semantic. Enforces invariant 5.3.

verdict.description: PASS=permit, FAIL=hard deny, REVIEW=deny-pending-human, INDETERMINATE=deny require override.

evidence.description: Hashed EvidenceIR the predicate was checked against. May be empty only for INDETERMINATE.

lift_authority.description: Who may consume a PASS, e.g. policy-fabric.

obligations.description: ObligationIR duties attached on consume, e.g. post_hoc.reverify_remote_ref within 300s.

override_of.description: Present only on human-authority override artifacts (invariant 5.5): the artifact_id / hash of the denying artifact being overridden.

operator.description: Present only on human-authority override artifacts (invariant 5.5): the attributed operator identity.

allOf.$comment: Invariant 5.5: a human-authority artifact must attribute the override and its target.

layer.description: semantic=task outcome; transport=tool ran. See invariant 5.3.

mode.description: presence=observed payload; absence=absence-based finding, gated by invariant 5.4.

signal.description: The extractor signal matched, e.g. regex:/build failed/i.

observed_at.description: When observed; if present, must fall within evidence_window.

kind.description: Invariant 5.1: MUST NOT be a model. human-authority is reserved for attributed overrides (5.5).

signature.description: Optional hardening (open item 10.4): a verifiable signature over the attestation by the recorder.

value.description: base64(signature) over canonical serialization of the artifact with the signature object removed.
